name: Yutong Bus Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yutong Bus Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells buses in China and internationally. It operates through Bus Manufacturing, Foreign Trade, and Other segments. The company offers e-buses, e-coaches, city buses, coaches, vans, airport buses, public security and emergency response vehicles, and medical vehicles. It also provides various e-solutions, including electric vehicle, service package, integrated new energy, sustainable mobility, integrated urban, and tournament solutions; charging station planning and construction services; online troubleshooting services, including on-site support with real-time monitoring and proactive diagnostics; and diversified training …
